description:
Analysis code, input data and outputs for the PeerJ manuscript #147031 (revision 1). Run python run_all.py data/otu_table2_with_taxonomy.xlsx --output-dir outputs to regenerate the main-text results, Supplementary Tables S1–S6 and Figures 2–5, and python revision_analysis.py data/otu_table2_with_taxonomy.xlsx --output-dir outputs_revision to regenerate the analyses added during peer review (Tables S1 and S1b under the primary and union rules, Table S5, Table S7 PERMANOVA with animal as an explicit model term, and revised Figures 3 and 5). Deterministic: PERMANOVA seed 1, rarefaction seed 42, 1,999 permutations.

Changes in v2.1.0: README data-availability statement corrected (raw reads are publicly available in the NCBI SRA under BioProject PRJNA1464423 / SRA study SRP699482); revision_analysis.py added; Figure 2 labels revised (label-only change); SHA256SUMS updated. The code for the revision analyses (revision_analysis.py) was written with the assistance of an AI tool (Claude, Anthropic) and reviewed by the authors.
